
garak$ $CC $CFLAGS $CPPFLAGS -c -o endian.o ../sysinfo/endian.c 
garak$ $CC $CFLAGS $CPPFLAGS -c -o sysinfo.o ../sysinfo/sysinfo.c
garak$ $CC $CFLAGS $CPPFLAGS -I../time_and_date -c -o tdiff.o ../time_and_date/tdiff.c
garak$ $CC $CFLAGS $CPPFLAGS -c -o gmp_mpfr_ver.o gmp_mpfr_ver.c
garak$ $CC $CFLAGS $CPPFLAGS -I../time_and_date -I../sysinfo -c -o fgruenberger.o \
> fgruenberger.c
garak$ $CC $CFLAGS $CPPFLAGS -o fgruenberger fgruenberger.o endian.o sysinfo.o \
> tdiff.o gmp_mpfr_ver.o -lgmp -lmpfr -lcrypto -lm
